components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 26px; padding: 0 24px; height: 76px; background: #FFFFFF; font-family: Archivo, 'Arial Narrow', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; padding: 6px 0; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted, #3F5536); text-decoration: none; transition: color .2s; } .ds-nav a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 2px; background: var(--green, #2D7A28); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: 0 50%; transition: transform .25s ease; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current] { color: var(--ink, #17260F); } .ds-nav a:hover::after, .ds-nav a[aria-current]::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--green, #2D7A28); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav .ds-nav-cta { margin-left: auto; padding: 12px 20px; min-height: 46px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: var(--green, #2D7A28); color: #FFFFFF; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav .ds-nav-cta::after { display: none; } .ds-nav .ds-nav-cta:hover { background: var(--green-hover, #22601F); color: #FFFFFF; }

narrative.overview:
A builder's portfolio that reads like the houses it shows: real photographs and videos carried full-bleed, white ground, and a single roof pitch that slices the page where a roof would meet the sky. The system is green and white only, taken from the logo's leaf and its darker forest tone. Everything that is an action is leaf green; everything that is a panel is forest green with white text. Nothing floats: depth comes from alternating bands and the angled cuts, never from shadows or rules.

One type family, Archivo, does all the work by changing width: condensed (62 to 70%) and heavy for headings, project data and the big numbers; normal width for reading text. Corners are square throughout. Density is calm on the band level (generous vertical padding) and compact inside components (tight chips, square buttons, stacked data).

Motion is gentle and limited to entrance: the hero rises, the hero photo settles, section parts rise on scroll where scroll timelines exist. Videos and photos stay fixed in the layout; nothing is pinned or scroll-linked.
keyCharacteristics: Green and white only: white ground, pale-leaf alternate bands, forest-green panels.
Leaf green marks every action; light leaf takes that role on forest panels.
One family, two widths: condensed Archivo for headings and numbers, normal width for text.
Square corners on every button, chip, field, tab and frame.
The roof-angle cut is the signature silhouette.
Flat: no shadows, no hairline borders.

rules.name: The Action Is Leaf Rule
rules.body: Anything tappable that commits an action is filled leaf green on light ground and light leaf on forest ground. No other hue carries action.

rules.name: The Two Greens Rule
rules.body: The palette is the logo's green and white. Do not add a third brand hue; new surfaces use the existing tints (pale leaf, leaf tone) or the forest panel.

rules.name: The Material Exception Rule
rules.body: The wall cross-section draws wood, PET wool and drywall in their own material tones (warm wood browns, off-white wool, pale grey board). These describe physical materials inside the schematic only and never leave it as UI color.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Archivo is the only typeface. Hierarchy comes from width, weight and size, never from a second family.

rules.name: The Width Is Voice Rule
rules.body: Condensed width (62 to 70%) belongs to headings, numbers and data values; reading text stays at 100% width.

rules.name: The Value Above Name Rule
rules.body: In project data, the value is set large in the title voice and its term sits below it in the small muted label.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow. A surface stands out by tone, never by lift.

rules.name: The No Hairline Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are separated by tone, not by 1px rules. The only strokes are the 2px outline of the line button, the 2px field border that appears on hover and focus, and the 2px nav underline.

dos: Do fill every action leaf green on light ground and light leaf on forest panels.
Do set headings, project values and big numbers in condensed Archivo (62 to 70% width, 800 to 900) and reading text at normal width.
Do keep every corner square (0 radius).
Do separate sections by alternating white, pale leaf and forest bands, and use the roof-angle cut where a panel band overlaps the band above.
Do cap reading text at 62ch and lead lines near 30 to 34ch.
Do keep motion to entrance rises and the hero photo settle, and honor reduced motion.
donts: Don't add shadows to any surface, button or image.
Don't separate content with 1px hairline borders or divider rules.
Don't introduce a second typeface or a third brand hue.
Don't round corners on buttons, chips, fields or frames.
Don't pin, scroll-link or animate project videos and photos beyond the entrance rise.
Don't use the wall schematic's wood and board tones outside the cross-section.
